quoted.text:
Nobody likes AI replies but they're defending each other

Because they're part of a giant network of people who all are using AI bots to spam X replies, and people selling them the shady tools to do that including bot farms, telephone farms etc. They all defend each other on here

When you poke a hornet's nest, they all come out to sting you, which they're doing to me today

Remember @nikitabier's work on original content and demonetizing all the automated spam? That was the same thing and it got so vicious he had security issues due to it

So yes nobody likes AI replies, it's just a self sustaining ecosystem on here with a lot of people dependent on it to make money from X monetization and the shady businesses selling them the automation tools and bot farms to do so

I'd call it a criminal enterprise
quoted.text_zh:
没人喜欢 AI 回复，但他们却在互相袒护。

因为他们同属一个庞大的网络：里面的人都在用 AI 机器人刷 X 回复，还有人向他们出售做这件事的灰色工具，包括机器人农场、电话农场等等。他们在这里彼此袒护。

你一旦捅了马蜂窝，它们就会倾巢而出叮你，今天它们就是这样对我的。

还记得 @nikitabier 推动原创内容、取消所有自动垃圾内容变现的事情吗？当时也是一样，闹得非常凶，他还因此遇到了安全问题。

所以没错，没人喜欢 AI 回复，这里只是一个自我维持的生态系统，很多人靠它从 X 变现赚钱，还有那些向他们出售自动化工具和机器人农场的灰色生意。

我称之为一个犯罪企业。
